content: {"like":["Opening 15-20 minutes are arguably the best part of the film","Strong special effects typical of Trek films","Some of the best cinematography in the franchise thanks to John A. Alonzo","Strong performances by Patrick Stewart as Picard","Strong performance by Malcolm McDowell as villain Soran","William Shatner’s best moments, especially in the opening sequence on the Enterprise B"],"dislike":["Film feels like a two‑part TV episode translated to the big screen","Structure and pacing are far better suited for TV, with obvious ad‑break cues","Odd moments where all characters contribute, e.g., Crusher briefing Riker and Worf in sick bay","Jarring scene breaks that disrupt flow, especially in the first hour","Data’s emotion chip used for cringe‑worthy comedy with little purpose","Over‑reliance on Next Generation continuity that feels odd for casual fans","Bland writing for Scotty and Chekov, making them seem interchangeable","Overall structural issues and pacing make the film disappointing"]}
